verdict.rationale: AngelList's conversions docs say the product produces an Excel-based pro forma with underlying formulas, in a format meant for legal teams and prospective investors. This covers SAFE-conversion pro-forma modeling and sharing by export. The docs also note that customers are being transitioned to other cap table providers, which casts doubt on the offering's continuity. Missing for 10: option pool top-up modeling, explicit dilution and priced-round scenario modeling, in-platform scenario sharing with counsel and investors (export only), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can model a priced round — dilution, option pool top-up, SAFE conversion, pro-forma ownership — and share the scenario with counsel and investors

citations.quote: It will produce an Excel-based pro forma (the format that your legal team and prospective investors will want to see it in because it contains the underlying formulas).
Once you've legally executed a SAFE/Convertible Note conversion, you can record the conversion and upload the conversion agreements in your cap table
